_comment: User-editable bank. Two slot families, both filled by LIBRARY_MATCH (best tag/keyword match to the posting, each entry used once): JOB_<i>_TITLE (the job-title line, company/date kept verbatim) and EXP_<i>_BULLET (that job's bullet positions). i is résumé order: 0=Mutual of Omaha Sr, 1=Adjunct Professor, 2=Web Platforms Engineer, 3=Union Pacific. Entries WITHOUT `fabricated` are real and always eligible; entries WITH `fabricated:true` are made-up/spun and only join the pool at aggressiveness >= 3, so low settings stay truthful. Add more entries per slot than there are positions to turn reordering into real selection.
